checks: Exact embedded assets start with no shell or inference
Project search stays idle until a user requests it
Files menu exposes New file and a platform-specific Find file shortcut
New file rejects empty, traversal and existing paths without changing disk
New file creates a nested project file and opens it ready to edit
File picker bounds results and browses folders using only keys
Find file button searches nested basenames and disambiguates duplicate paths
Cmd/Ctrl P opens a nested basename without expanding its folders
Enter after a fast query change opens the latest requested match
Fast typing and Enter open nested paths and cited lines
Escape returns native focus and selection without opening work
A queued native close event preserves a newer code selection and reopened palette
Parent navigation and filenames with spaces work without mouse input
Project command switches files, AI and terminal context together
Colon still types normally when Vim navigation is off
Opt-in Vim navigation never inserts command keys and handles Unicode
Insert and Escape preserve text; :q protects dirty buffers; :w saves
Vim choice persists per browser and closing a saved file uses :q
File commands reject traversal, outside roots and symlinks with a recoverable error
Hostile filenames remain text and unknown commands never execute shell text
AI, code and an existing terminal are reachable entirely through commands
Finding a file from AI or terminal returns to the code editor
Composition and native dialogs fence global keyboard shortcuts
Picker is scrollable and fits desktop and short phone viewports
New and Find file actions stay visible and touch-sized on short phone viewports
Read-only paired devices can find files while both New file actions stay disabled
No AI request, rendering errors or background file scan
limits: Physical phones and native mobile keyboards were not exercised.
